name: Todd's How-to-Hunt

items_removed_on_completion.basis: Derived, not explicit: MeowDB's quest database "Requirement type" filter treats item requirements as hand-ins (quests whose requirements are all items are listed as "Item hand-in only", items plus kills as "Items + monster kills"). MeowDB has no field saying which items are taken on completion.

lines.text: A new traveler, eh? Want to learn how to hunt? The Tutorial Jr. Sentinels you see here are normally too powerful for you to handle, but Grendel the Really Old, the head of all magicians, sealed up their power. So take down three, pick up what they drop, and go see Peter, who should be around here somewhere.

start/end NPC ids, names, maps, region MapleIsland, quest and turn-in lists

gaps: MeowDB has no maximum level for quests (max_level is null).
MeowDB has no map-visit objectives or per-objective map restrictions for quests.

MeowDB has no explicit "items removed on completion" field; items_removed_on_completion is derived from MeowDB's quest database "Requirement type" filter, which labels item requirements "Item hand-in only" / "Items + monster kills".
MeowDB does not say which "On completion" lines are shown before vs after the reward is given, or how dialogue pages are split into NPC chat windows.

discrepancies.reason: item-db 347 has icon key 4000000, equal to the quest payload's itemId, and its page https://meowdb.com/msclassic/item-db/347 links this quest; item-db 2584 is a different item with the same name (icon key 4000067; its page does not link this quest). The dialogue link appears to be resolved by name. https://meowdb.com/_data/safe-to-sell.json lists "Jr. Sentinel Shellpiece" as an ambiguous name (item-db 347, 2584) and resolves it by name to 2584, the same id as the dialogue link: MeowDB's own name-based resolution produces 2584 for this name, independent of the quest.
